notes.title: Gamepad Feature
notes.content: Added the ability to manipulate your bullet trajectory with Left Anolog Stick while shooting as long as the Right Anolog stick is not being used to aim. Right Anolog Stick will always be prioritized over Left Anolog Stick to aim.

notes.title: QoL Update - New Map & Save System
notes.content:
[b]WARNING: Files created before Nov. 29 no longer contain saved data. Attempting to load into those files will cause the game to crash. Please delete them.[/b]

QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES/ADDITIONS:

[b]1.[/b] The map has been re-created from the ground up to display your exact position and more accurately show the collision of the room while hiding some secrets. Icons have also been added to the map (Save Room, Map Station, BioShop).

[b]2.[/b] Control Tips UI has been updated to display above Bek's sprite.

[b]3.[/b] Main Menu has been altered. New Game and Load Game have been replaced with Game Files.

[b]4.[/b] Stats Menu now displays collectable items with descriptions.

[b]5.[/b] Additional rooms have been added.

[b]6.[/b] Various bug fixes and tweaks to systems.

notes.title: QoL Additions/Changes
notes.content:
[u][b]QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES/ADDITIONS:[/b][/u]

notes.title: Added Feature & Adjustments
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] You can now toggle D-Pad Movement by pressing and holding down the Left Thumb Stick..

[b]2.[/b] Various Bug Fixes.

[b]3.[/b] Balanced sfx volumes.

notes.title: Bug Fixes (11-8-21)
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] Bio-Shop items stock now track between different Bio-Shop locations.

[b]2.[/b] Fixed a bug where defeating the Octolis before speaking to Otterman would trigger a specific dialogue every time you enter the shop.

[b]3.[/b] Added in keybinding for A and D. (Only accessible with a new file)

[b]4.[/b] (Burst Boost required) Fixed a bug where Hover wouldn't trigger until after you started falling from a Burst Boost.

notes.title: Refined Jumping for Gamepad
notes.content: Made a few polishing touches for Jumping with Left Trigger which can only be done when Hover is assigned to Left Trigger on Gamepad.

notes.title: Key binding addition.
notes.content: [b]1.[/b] Added the ability to re-map movement (A and D) on the keyboard.

notes.title: Bug Fixes | Adjsustments (11-04-21)
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] Fixed a bug where the D-Pad would not move the cursor up and down in the pause menu.

[b]2.[/b] Updated the Desktop Icon.

[b]3.[/b] Fixed a bug where pressing (B) on Keyboard or Gamepad while remapping actions would cause you to go back to the previous menu.

[b]4.[/b] Fixed a bug where starting a new game would set SFX and Music to 0.

[b]5.[/b] Made adjustments to some of the rooms in the Womb.

notes.title: Hot Fix (11-04-21)
notes.content: [b]1.[/b] Fixed a bug where starting a new game would set SFX and Music to 0.

notes.title: Bug Fixes (11-04-21)
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] Fixed a bug where pressing the D-Pad (Left) while in Load Game or New Game would bring up the Bug Fixes page.

[b]2.[/b] Removed the ability to control the Octolis using the arrow keys.

[b]3.[/b] Refined custom binding for keyboard and gamepad. You also no longer have to assign every action to a key or button to leave the Remap Menu pages.

[b]4.[/b] Hover is now re-mappable on Gamepad.

[b]5.[/b] Fixed a bug where audio SFX and Music settings reset back to 80% when moving from room to room..

notes.title: Bug Fixes (11-02-21)
notes.content:
[b]1.[/b] Fixed a bug where dashing into a slope would cause the dash cooldown timer to be delayed resulting in not being able to dash for several seconds.

[b]2.[/b] Removed the ability to leave the Phorgog Boss room until the DNA formation animation is completed. Leaving prematurely would cause a soft lock.

[b]3.[/b] Disabled the Folice Waves in the Phorgog Boss room when the Phorgog is defeated.

[b]4.[/b] Fixed a bug that causes the game to crash when starting a new game after having returned from a loaded or new file.
 
[b]5.[/b] Tweaks and Adjustments made to Phorgog Boss.

notes.title: Bug Fixes (11-01-21)
notes.content:
"[b]1.[/b] Fixed a Bug that caused Mouse Left Click when clicking on (Exit to Menu) to hang and save the clicking state. Because of this, when loading back into a game file and opening the pause menu, the first option you hovered over would be selected without clicking

[b]2.[/b] Fixed a bug that allowed the player to move prematurely when loading from a save file into the Bio-Shop. Doing so would cause the player to be stuck in a running animation.

[b]3.[/b] Added Zeropadding to Total Playtime and elsewhere. Was originally shown as (1 : 1 : 1). Will now show as (1 : 01 : 01).

[b]4.[/b] Corrected grammatical errors.

[b]5.[/b] Updated Hepato's secondary dialogue."

notes.title: Bug Fixes (10-30-21)
notes.content:
"1. Fixed a bug where some audio that looped would not stop when pausing the game. We may have missed a few others. Please let us know if you run into other sounds that don't stop besides music and ambience.

2. Updated the way the Audio picks up the Pink Spike Folics positional sound. It should sound more pleasent and not as loud.

3. ixed bugs relating to the Pause Menu and Menu UI interfering with each other on the main menu. 

4. Fixed a few gramamatical errors with dialogue.

5. ITEM % will now display accurately. Before this update, Items could count twice and some wouldn't count at all. Currently you can not go above 100% if you've collected all the intentional collectables. We recommend you try a new file in case you are over 100%. You may have missed some collectables.

6. Updated a few collisions the player could get snagged on.

7. Added ''Lighting'' to the Goraknis Acid making it more visible in dark places.

8. Mission Notifications will not pop up twice if you recieve the notification and immediately enter into another room."

notes.title: BugFixes (10-29-21)2
notes.content:
Fixed a Bug where you weren't able to open your submenu unless you were next to a AtomicStation. 

Turned off visibility for Crusher Collisions.

notes.title: BUG FIXES (10-29-21)
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where Phorgog Feepup Carries could spawn fragments when shot at after already being destroyed.

2. Fixed a bug where the Pink Folic Spikes audio would loop when in the pause menu or when off screen at times.

3. Fixed an issue where falling into the Pink Liquid at (Metabolite: Vascular Passage) would reset the player into the ground.

4. Fixed a bug where Enzymes (Floating Goo) would sometimes spawn in twice.

5. Added ‘Temporary’ collisions to prevent players from jumping over the Vascular System Transport and getting stuck. We will revisit this and do something more clever than collisions, later on.

6. Fixed a bug where dashing into the train could sometimes cause the game to not send you into the next layout.

7. Removed the ability to open up the submenu while standing on the Atomic Station. Doing so would cause interference with the submenu and the buttons that triggered the Atomic Station Actions. 

8. Fixed a bug where elevators wouldn’t crush you if they landed on you or raised you into the ceiling. Causing you to get pinned in the collision.
